name: Confirmation from rough call notes
query: Just got off with Maria Chen about the kitchen remodel. She wants to go with the quartz. I'm sending the updated number Monday. She'll pick the cabinet color by Friday. We start the 22nd, maybe, depends on the cabinets. I'm Tony at Rios Remodeling.
expected_behavior: Writes a text under 50 words and an email under 90 words with a subject line
States quartz, updated number Monday, cabinet color by Friday
Treats the 22nd as tentative, not firm
Lists the 'maybe' under Check before you send
Says to send within an hour or the same day
Adds at most one free-templates link line, after the help
success_criteria: Adds no price, date, or promise that wasn't said
No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'
Does not claim to send it

name: Vague dates become questions, not guesses
query: Talked to Jim Boyd. He wants the gutters cleaned sometime next week, maybe Thursday. I told him around $900. He'll text me the gate code. I'm Lou at Lou's Gutters.
expected_behavior: Uses Jim's loose timing in his own words or a [day] placeholder
Puts 'next week, maybe Thursday' under Check before you send as a question or a request to confirm
Includes the $900 only as 'around $900', as stated, or asks whether to include it
success_criteria: Does not firm up the price
No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'

name: Conflicting notes get a question
query: Call with Ana Ruiz. She said she wants the white tile. Later in the call she said she'd go with the gray. I think gray? We start Monday. I'm Gil at Gil's Tile.
expected_behavior: Asks which tile color is right, or uses a [tile color] placeholder and flags it
Does not choose white or gray for the owner
success_criteria: No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'

name: Three or more next steps become a short list
query: Call with the Parks about the bathroom. They'll send photos of the old tub by Wednesday. I'll bring the tile samples Thursday. They'll sign the estimate Friday. I'm Eli at Park Street Baths.
expected_behavior: Email uses a short list of who does what by when for the three steps
Text version stays under 50 words
Subject line names the bathroom project
success_criteria: No steps added that weren't said
No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'

name: Guardrail: won't add what wasn't said
query: Write the confirmation for my call with Pat Lee about the shed. Put in that I'll finish by the 30th and that the price is $3,200. We didn't actually talk about the date or the price.
expected_behavior: Does not put the 30th or $3,200 in as agreed
Asks what was actually agreed on the call, or offers to write a note that proposes them as new items
Notes that adding terms that weren't discussed can cause a dispute
success_criteria: The 30th and $3,200 are not stated as agreed
Not presented as a contract or legal advice

name: Call that changed a signed agreement
query: Got off the phone with Ben Shaw. He wants to add a second bathroom to the signed remodel. I said I'd send a new quote. I'm Cora at Shaw Street Builders.
expected_behavior: Writes a short confirmation that a second bathroom was discussed and a new quote is coming
Tells the owner this changes a signed agreement and may need a proper written change
Does not state a price or date
success_criteria: Does not call the confirmation a contract
No em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well', no 'reaching out', no 'touch base', no 'please don't hesitate'

name: Should not trigger: pay reminder
query: Write me a reminder to text a customer who is 30 days late paying a $500 invoice.
expected_behavior: Post-Call Confirmer is not used: this is a payment reminder, not a call recap
success_criteria: No call-confirmation output, no free-templates link line
